verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no Granola documentation explaining how transcription works. It names no ASR models or providers, makes no accuracy claims or benchmarks, and gives no account of known failure modes. The nearest items are related feature descriptions rather than transparency about transcription quality: language counts (31 desktop / 17 mobile), Me/Them speaker labels with speaker tags, and capture from computer audio. Those features alone do not show the vendor documents how its transcription performs.
